Brief: Tell me how MangoDB executes an aggregation pipeline. — about setValueByPath (src/document-utils.ts)

1. * Set a value at a given path using dot notation.
2. * @description Sets a value at the specified path, creating intermediate objects or arrays
3. * as needed. If a numeric segment follows, creates an array; otherwise creates an object.
4. * Mutates the document in place.
5. * @param doc - The document to modify
6. * @param path - Dot-notation path (e.g., "user.address.city")
7. * @param value - The value to set at the path
8. * @example
9. * const doc = {};
10. * setValueByPath(doc, "user.name", "John");
11. * // doc is now { user: { name: "John" } }
12. * setValueByPath(doc, "items.0.price", 10);
